description: Modelled on the Trinity client's Renovate config, minus its patch automerge: every update here arrives as a pull request a maintainer merges.

Patches skip the dashboard gate and open PRs straight away; minor and major updates wait for a tick on the dependency dashboard. minimumReleaseAge holds every release for three days, so a version yanked soon after publishing never reaches a branch.
Commits and PR titles are build(deps): …, which commitlint and the PR title check accept and release-please keeps out of the changelog.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the dashboard gate and soak for one day instead of three, the same minimumReleaseAge pnpm applies to installs.

packageRules.description: Patches need no dashboard tick; they still open a pull request.
Nx packages must move in lockstep.
wrangler and the Vitest plugin share the workerd runtime, so update them together.
GitHub Actions digests are grouped into one PR.
